laws.rule: Tapantí: daily 8 am to 4 pm, tickets online only. Non-resident adults US$10 (about A$14.20 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026), children 2 to 12 US$5 (about A$7.10 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026). No swimming in rivers or streams, no entry drunk or on drugs, no pets, no smoking (Law 9028), no leaving trails.
